startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Shopee page URLs to screenshot (product, shop, search). Each storefront (shopee.vn, shopee.co.th, …) needs its own saved login session in the named key-value store `shopee-session` (see README).

fullPage.title: Full Page Screenshot
fullPage.description: Capture the page from the top down to Max Capture Height (lazy-loads it first) instead of just the viewport.

maxScrollHeight.title: Max Capture Height
maxScrollHeight.description: Full-page captures scroll down this far (loading what Shopee shows on the way) and stop here. 5000 px covers a product with its details, description and the start of its reviews.

viewportWidth.title: Window Width
viewportWidth.description: Browser window width in pixels, applied with --window-size rather than a viewport override.

viewportHeight.title: Window Height
viewportHeight.description: Browser window height in pixels. A headed window spends ~90px on browser chrome; full-page captures are unaffected.

hideAccount.title: Hide Logged-in Account
hideAccount.description: Hide the avatar and username of the scraper's Shopee account in the page's top bar.

proxy.title: Use Apify Residential Proxy
proxy.description: On: Apify residential proxy in the storefront's country (shopee.vn → VN), one fixed session per storefront so the IP changes as little as Apify allows. Off: the machine's own IP. Ignored when Static Proxy URL is set.

proxyUrl.title: Static Proxy URL
proxyUrl.description: Optional http://user:pass@host:port of a static proxy in the storefront's country. Used instead of Apify Proxy, so the account always browses from the same IP: Shopee grows suspicious of one account seen from many IPs.

headless.title: Headless Browser
headless.description: Leave this OFF. Shopee refuses headless Chrome even with a valid login (measured 2026-11-20). The Apify base image runs an Xvfb display, so headed works on the platform.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Safety cap on the total number of requests (including retries) made by this run.
